newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices soften with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices soften with NYMEX.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices turned softer again on Thursday, as additional field receipts arrived in Alberta and futures faltered, market sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub for Friday delivery eased to about C$1.54-1.55 per gigajoule, down about five cents from Wednesday. July AECO was quoted at C$1.56-1.57, off about four cents.
NYMEX's July Henry Hub gas futures expired today 8.2 cents lower at $2.145, just 2.5 cents shy of the session low.
